# How much of your backdoor Roth conversion is taxable?

> Free calculator for the backdoor Roth pro-rata rule: how much of your Roth conversion is taxable given your after-tax basis and your December 31 traditional, SEP and SIMPLE IRA balance, plus the tax you could avoid by rolling pre-tax money into a 401(k). Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
